ERR_IO_PIN_IN_USE.message: {pin} of {id} is already set up as {mode}
ERR_IO_PIN_IN_USE.hint: Reset the pin first, or keep its mode: a pin is set up once.

ERR_IO_PIN_UNCONFIGURED.message: {pin} of {id} is not set up yet
ERR_IO_PIN_UNCONFIGURED.hint: Set the pin's mode first (Devices: the pin's Mode, or Set mode), then use it.

ERR_IO_WRONG_MODE.message: {pin} of {id} is {mode}: it cannot do that
ERR_IO_WRONG_MODE.hint: Use a command that fits the pin's mode, or reset the pin and set another mode.

ERR_IO_MODE_UNSUPPORTED.hint: Choose a mode this pin offers, or another pin.

ERR_IO_FEATURE_UNSUPPORTED.hint: Use a pin that has it (the device page lists what each pin can do).

ERR_IO_PWM_CHANNELS_EXHAUSTED.message: {pin} of {id}: all {channels} PWM channels are in use
ERR_IO_PWM_CHANNELS_EXHAUSTED.hint: Reset a PWM pin you no longer need, or use a PWM expander.

ERR_IO_PWM_TIMERS_EXHAUSTED.message: {pin} of {id}: no PWM timer is free for {frequency_Hz} (all {timers} in use)
ERR_IO_PWM_TIMERS_EXHAUSTED.hint: Use a frequency another PWM pin already runs at, or reset a PWM pin you no longer need.

ERR_IO_BAD_READING.hint: Read it again; if it keeps failing, restart the board.
